newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paribas up after Massonaud ups rating.
newsitem.headline: Paribas up after Massonaud ups rating.

text.p: Shares in Paribas rose sharply on the bourse on Monday after brokerage Massonaud raised its rating on the stock to buy from neutral, market sources said.
Paribas shares were up 2.47 percent at 369.50 francs at 1010 GMT in a flat market.

Massonaud set a six-month objective for the stock of 450 francs and estimated the re-evaluated net assets at 510 francs per share. Given Paribas' objective to focus on international banking activities, Massonaud expects Paribas to make an acquisition in the sector.
